title: Pelvic Floor for Everyone — Leaks, Prolapse and Diastasis Recti

hook.en: Roughly one in three women leaks urine at some point, and many men leak after prostate surgery, yet most never tell anyone. In Pakistan shame is the real barrier. A calm, private, evidence-based conversation can change a life.
hook.ur: Takreeban teen mein se ek aurat kabhi na kabhi peshab ka rishaw mehsoos karti hai, aur bohat se mard prostate surgery ke baad, lekin zyada tar kisi ko nahi batate. Pakistan mein sharam asal rukawat hai. Pur-sukoon, nijji, saboot par mabni baat zindagi badal sakti hai.

goal.en: By the end, you'll explain what the pelvic floor does, name the common problems (stress and urge leakage, prolapse, diastasis recti, men after prostate surgery), teach a correct pelvic floor contraction, know when NOT to teach Kegels, and recognise red flags.
goal.ur: End tak aap pelvic floor ka kaam samjhayenge, aam masail (stress aur urge rishaw, prolapse, diastasis recti, prostate surgery ke baad mard) ke naam batayenge, sahi pelvic floor contraction sikhayenge, jaanenge ke Kegels kab NAHI sikhane, aur red flags pehchanenge.

text.en: The **pelvic floor** is a sling of muscles at the base of the pelvis. It supports the bladder, bowel and womb or prostate, helps close the exits (urethra, anus), plays a part in sexual function and works with the deep abdominal muscles, diaphragm and back muscles as a team. Problems come in two directions: **too weak** (leakage, heaviness) or **too tight** (pain, difficulty emptying, pain with intercourse). The same exercise is not right for both.
text.ur: **Pelvic floor** pelvis ki tah mein muscles ka jhoola hai. Yeh mutha, aantein aur bachedani ya prostate ko sahara deta hai, nikasi ke rasto (urethra, anus) ko band karne mein madad karta hai, jinsi function mein hissa leta hai aur gehre pait ke muscles, diaphragm aur peeth ke muscles ke saath team ban kar kaam karta hai. Masail do rukh mein aate hain: **bohat kamzor** (rishaw, bhaari pan) ya **bohat tight** (dard, khali karne mein mushkil, jima mein dard). Dono ke liye ek hi exercise theek nahi.

text.en: Think of a **hammock under a bag of shopping**. If the hammock is slack, the bag sags and leaks when you cough. If it is clamped too tight, nothing moves easily and it hurts. A healthy floor lifts when needed and relaxes completely afterwards.
text.ur: **Khareed ke thaile ke neeche jhoola** sochein. Agar jhoola dheela ho to thaila lataka rehta hai aur khansne par rishaw hota hai. Agar bohat kasa ho to kuch aasani se nahi hilta aur dard hota hai. Sehatmand floor zaroorat par uthta hai aur baad mein mukammal dheela hota hai.

title.en: Common pelvic floor problems: what the patient says and the first step
title.ur: Aam pelvic floor masail: mareez kya kehta hai aur pehla qadam

rows.en: "I leak when I cough, sneeze, jump or lift"

rows.en: Supervised pelvic floor muscle training, usually first-line
rows.ur: Nigrani mein pelvic floor muscle training, aam taur par pehla ilaaj

rows.en: "I get a sudden strong need and cannot hold on"
rows.ur: "Achanak tez hajat hoti hai aur rok nahi pata"

rows.en: Bladder training, fluid and caffeine review, urge suppression, and PFMT
rows.ur: Bladder training, paani aur caffeine ka jaiza, urge suppression aur PFMT

rows.en: "A heaviness or bulge in the vagina, worse by evening or lifting"
rows.ur: "Wajaina mein bhaari pan ya ubhaar, shaam ya uthane par zyada"

rows.en: Pelvic floor training, avoid heavy straining, consider a pessary through a clinician
rows.ur: Pelvic floor training, zor lagane se bachein, clinician ke zariye pessary par ghaur

rows.en: "A ridge or bulge in my tummy after pregnancy"
rows.ur: "Hamal ke baad pait mein ubhaar ya lakeer"

rows.ur: Tadreeji core aur poore jism ki taqat, sirf gap ki chaudai nahi function par kaam

rows.ur: Physiotherapist ke saath shuruaati pelvic floor training, aur recovery ka saaf plan

rows.en: "Pain with intercourse, constipation, cannot empty fully"
rows.ur: "Jima mein dard, qabz, mukammal khali nahi hota"

rows.ur: Relaxation, saans aur stretch; mazeed Kegels NAHI

title.en: Teaching a correct pelvic floor contraction

steps.title: Get consent and privacy
steps.detail: Explain what you will do, use a private room, offer a chaperone and only do an internal examination if trained, with permission, and when needed. Most teaching needs none. || Razamandi aur nijiyat lein

steps.title: Find the muscle
steps.detail: Ask the patient to imagine stopping the flow of wind or gently lifting the pelvic floor up and in, without squeezing the buttocks or thighs or holding the breath. Do not ask them to practise by stopping the urine flow, because it can disturb bladder emptying. || Muscle dhoondein

steps.title: Hold, release and repeat
steps.detail: Teach a lift, a short hold, then a full release, repeated a few times, and build up slowly over weeks. Full relaxation matters as much as the squeeze. || Pakrein, chhorein, dohrayein

steps.title: Use it in daily life
steps.detail: Practise the lift just before a cough, a sneeze or a lift (the knack) and fit it into walking, sitting and standing so it becomes automatic. || Rozmarra mein istemal karein

question.en: A 35-year-old woman leaks when she jumps on a trampoline and when she coughs. She has no pain and empties her bladder easily. What is the best first-line plan?
question.ur: 35 saal ki aurat trampoline par koodte aur khansne par rishaw mehsoos karti hai. Dard nahi aur mutha aasani se khali hota hai. Behtareen pehle darje ka plan kya hai?

text.en: Supervised pelvic floor muscle training, with the knack and gradual return to impact
text.ur: Nigrani mein pelvic floor muscle training, knack ke saath aur impact par tadreeji wapsi

feedback.en: Yes — pelvic floor training is first-line for stress leakage, and it works best when supervised.
feedback.ur: Haan — pelvic floor training stress rishaw ka pehla ilaaj hai, aur nigrani mein behtar kaam karti hai.

text.ur: Hamesha ke liye har exercise band

feedback.en: Stopping all exercise is unnecessary and harmful.
feedback.ur: Har exercise band karna be-zaroorat aur nuqsandeh hai.

text.en: Tell her to stop her urine mid-stream every time she passes urine
text.ur: Har baar peshab ke beech mein rokne ko kahein

feedback.en: Doing this regularly can disturb normal emptying.
feedback.ur: Yeh baqaidgi se karna normal khali hone mein khalal daal sakta hai.

question.en: A woman has pain with intercourse, constipation and a sense that she cannot fully empty her bladder. What should you NOT give her?
question.ur: Ek aurat ko jima mein dard, qabz aur mutha mukammal khali na hone ka ehsaas hai. Usay kya NAHI dena chahiye?

text.en: Referral to a pelvic health physiotherapist

feedback.en: A good plan for painful symptoms.
feedback.ur: Dardnak alamaat ke liye achha plan.

text.en: Diaphragmatic breathing with relaxation and gentle stretching
text.ur: Diaphragmatic breathing relaxation aur narm stretch ke saath

feedback.en: This is a sensible first step for a tight floor.
feedback.ur: Tight floor ke liye yeh samajhdaar pehla qadam hai.

text.ur: Mazboot, baar baar Kegel strengthening exercises

feedback.en: Yes — a tight, overactive floor needs relaxation first, and more squeezing can worsen it.
feedback.ur: Haan — tight, overactive floor ko pehle relaxation chahiye, aur zyada squeeze isay bigaad sakti hai.

question.en: A woman six months after delivery has a soft bulge along the midline of her tummy when she does a curl-up. She has no back pain and can lift her baby. What is the sensible approach?
question.ur: Delivery ke chhe mahine baad ek aurat ko curl-up karte waqt pait ki beech ki lakeer mein naram ubhaar hai. Peeth dard nahi aur woh apna bacha utha leti hai. Samajhdaar tareeqa kya hai?

text.en: Tell her she needs surgery now

feedback.ur: Surgery shayad hi pehle darje ka ilaaj hai.

text.en: Tell her never to do abdominal exercise again
text.ur: Kahein ke dobara kabhi pait ki exercise na kare

feedback.en: Avoiding all abdominal exercise is not needed.
feedback.ur: Pait ki har exercise se bachna zaroori nahi.

text.en: Reassure her and build gradual whole-body and core strength, focusing on function rather than the gap width
text.ur: Tasalli dein aur tadreeji poore jism aur core ki taqat banayein, gap ki chaudai nahi function par tawajjo

feedback.en: Yes — the gap size on its own does not predict function, and strength training is safe.
feedback.ur: Haan — gap ka size akela function ki peshgoi nahi karta, aur strength training mehfooz hai.

text.en: **Giving everyone Kegels, or teaching them wrongly.** Many women squeeze their buttocks, hold their breath or push down instead of lifting up. A tight, painful or overactive floor gets worse with more squeezing. Always ask about pain, emptying and constipation first, check the technique and teach relaxation as carefully as contraction.
text.ur: **Har kisi ko Kegels dena, ya ghalat sikhana.** Bohat si khawateen nitambon ko bheenchti hain, saans rokti hain ya oopar uthane ke bajaye neeche dhakelti hain. Tight, dardnak ya overactive floor mazeed squeeze se bigarta hai. Pehle dard, khali hone aur qabz ke baare mein poochhein, technique jaanchein aur contraction jitni ehtiyat se relaxation sikhayein.

text.en: **Make it safe to talk.** For example: "Many women and men notice this and it is very treatable, so you are not alone. What you tell me stays private. We can start with questions and a simple plan, and nothing intimate happens unless you agree." In Pakistan, offer a female clinician where possible, a private room and a respectful, unhurried pace, and frame the care as part of normal postnatal and ageing health.
text.ur: **Baat karna mehfooz banayein.** Misaal: "Bohat si khawateen aur mard yeh mehsoos karte hain aur iska ilaaj bohat mumkin hai, isliye aap akele nahi. Jo aap batayenge woh nijji rahega. Hum sawalon aur saade plan se shuru kar sakte hain, aur jab tak aap razi na hon koi nijji muaina nahi hoga." Pakistan mein mumkin ho to khatoon clinician, nijji kamra aur izzat bhara, bina jaldi ka andaaz paish karein, aur care ko hamal ke baad aur umar ke normal sehat ka hissa bana kar bayan karein.

question.en: Why does a pelvic floor that is "too weak" and one that is "too tight" sometimes look the same?
question.ur: "Bohat kamzor" aur "bohat tight" pelvic floor kabhi ek jaise kyun lagte hain?

answer.en: A tight muscle is often a tired, overworked muscle that cannot generate or relax properly, so a person can leak because the floor is overactive and cannot lift further. The history, examination and the patient's pain pattern separate them, which is why careful assessment matters before choosing the exercise.
answer.ur: Tight muscle aksar thaka, zyada kaam karne wala muscle hota hai jo theek se zor paida ya relax nahi kar pata, isliye shakhs is liye bhi leak kar sakta hai ke floor overactive hai aur mazeed oopar nahi uth sakta. Tareekh, muaina aur mareez ke dard ka andaaz in mein farq karte hain, isi liye exercise chunne se pehle ehtiyat se assessment zaroori hai.

beats.patient: A 55-year-old man is two weeks after a radical prostatectomy, with a catheter just removed and leaking when he stands. He is anxious and embarrassed.
beats.assessment: Leakage is expected early after prostate surgery; the sphincter and floor need rehabilitation. He needs a plan, privacy and reassurance.
beats.treatment: A physiotherapist teaches a correct contraction, the knack before standing or coughing, gradual progression, bladder habits, constipation avoidance and fluid advice, and the surgeon and physiotherapist share the plan.
beats.reassess: Over weeks to months, he leaks less; a clear timeline and follow-up keep him engaged.

text.en: **Red flags need a doctor first.** Blood in the urine, sudden inability to pass urine, new numbness around the saddle area or genitals with weakness in the legs or loss of bowel control (cauda equina), severe pelvic pain, fever with urinary symptoms, heavy bleeding or a hard lump, or unexplained weight loss. Never do an internal examination without training, consent, privacy and a chaperone, and follow local professional rules.
text.ur: **Red flags mein pehle doctor.** Peshab mein khoon, achanak peshab na kar pana, saddle ya jinsi hisson mein nayi sunnpan ke saath taangon mein kamzori ya paakhane par qaboo khona (cauda equina), shadeed pelvic dard, peshab ki alamat ke saath bukhar, bhaari bleeding ya sakht gaanth, ya be-wajah wazan kam hona. Training, razamandi, nijiyat aur chaperone ke baghair kabhi andar ka muaina na karein, aur muqami peshawar ranna ke qaide maniye.

text.en: A Cochrane review of pelvic floor muscle training for urinary incontinence in women found that it can cure or improve stress leakage and is recommended as first-line treatment, with better results when supervised and when the programme is intensive enough. The POPPY randomised trial of pelvic floor muscle training for women with symptomatic prolapse found improvement in prolapse symptoms in the trained group at 12 months. Evidence for pelvic floor training before and after prostate surgery in men is mixed, with some benefit reported for earlier recovery of continence.
text.ur: Women mein peshab ke rishaw ke liye pelvic floor muscle training ke Cochrane review ne paya ke yeh stress rishaw theek ya behtar kar sakta hai aur pehle darje ka ilaaj tajweez hota hai, behtar nateeje tab jab nigrani mein aur programme kaafi intensive ho. POPPY randomised trial mein alamati prolapse wali khawateen mein pelvic floor muscle training se training wale group mein 12 mahine par prolapse ki alamat mein behtari mili. Mardon mein prostate surgery se pehle aur baad pelvic floor training ke saboot mile-jule hain, aur continence ki jaldi wapsi mein kuch faida batayi gayi hai.

text.en: **Private, Check, Teach, Relax.** Make it private, check for pain and emptying, teach the lift, and teach full relaxation.
text.ur: **Private, Check, Teach, Relax.** Nijiyat banayein, dard aur khali hone ko jaanchein, lift sikhayein, aur mukammal relaxation sikhayein.

summary.en: The pelvic floor can be too weak or too tight; check which before choosing exercise.
summary.ur: Pelvic floor bohat kamzor ya bohat tight ho sakta hai; exercise chunne se pehle jaanchein kaun sa.

summary.en: Pelvic floor muscle training is first-line for stress leakage and works best when supervised and taught correctly.
summary.ur: Pelvic floor muscle training stress rishaw ka pehla ilaaj hai aur nigrani aur sahi tareeqe se sikhane par behtar kaam karti hai.

summary.en: Make it private and consensual, watch for red flags such as cauda equina, and reassure that diastasis recti is treatable with strength and function.
summary.ur: Nijiyat aur razamandi rakhein, cauda equina jaise red flags par nazar rakhein, aur tasalli dein ke diastasis recti taqat aur function se theek ho sakta hai.

front.ur: Kis masle mein mazeed Kegels ki bajaye relaxation chahiye?

back.en: A tight or overactive pelvic floor.
Lifting the pelvic floor just before a cough, sneeze or lift.
back.ur: Khansne, chheenkne ya uthane se pehle pelvic floor uthana.

back.ur: Nigrani mein pelvic floor muscle training.

back.en: Blood in urine, or saddle numbness with leg weakness.
back.ur: Peshab mein khoon, ya taangon ki kamzori ke saath saddle sunnpan.
